listing.name: Vertical Bar Agent
listing.shortDescription: Grounded CrossCheck and Vertical Bar workflows through a governed MCP service.

toolAnnotationNotes.screen_open: screen_open is readOnlyHint true, destructiveHint false, openWorldHint false (owner decision, RND-6352): it sends the screen only to the signed-in user's own open CrossCheck tabs and always returns its link, and stores or changes no CrossCheck, NetSuite or Shopify data; a tab with unsaved edits waits instead of moving.
toolAnnotationNotes.cc_preview_stress_test: cc_preview_stress_test stays readOnlyHint true with the optional testRef: the preview is compiled and shown on the user's open screen of that test (Keep or Discard there); nothing is stored by this call.

starterPrompts: Are we ready to close the books this month? Show me what changed in NetSuite since last close and anything that could block it.
Someone changed a workflow in production last week. Who did it, what depends on it, and what could break downstream?
Before we deploy Friday's release to production, prove the order-to-cash process still works end to end.
humanGates: Select the verified Vertical Bar business identity.
Use an account with Apps Management write permission.
Provide reviewer credentials out of band without MFA or private-network dependency.
Serve the exact portal-issued domain challenge token.
Submit for review and publish only after approval.
